name: Essentials — libraries, fonts, icons, media
description: Hand-picked free resources: animation libraries (Framer Motion, GSAP), fonts (Inter, Geist, Satoshi, Fontsource), icons and logos (Simple Icons, Logo.dev, Lucide, Phosphor, Tabler), illustrations, Lottie, stock media and palettes. Each entry links to the original with its license.

items.name: Framer Motion (Motion)
items.description: Best-in-class React animation library: springs, layout animation, gestures, scroll-linked motion. Already powers Cupric's own UI.

data.promptCue: Animate with springs and layout transitions; stagger children 40–80ms; prefer transform/opacity.

items.name: GSAP + React
items.description: Professional timeline animation engine with ScrollTrigger, SplitText and useGSAP for React — the alternative to Framer Motion for choreographed sequences.

data.license: GSAP Standard ‘no charge’ license (free, incl. plugins)
data.promptCue: Choreograph scenes as one timeline with labelled beats; use ScrollTrigger-style progress mapped to time.

items.name: Inter
items.description: Neutral, highly legible UI sans with variable weight. Bundled in Cupric (Inter Variable).

data.promptCue: Use Inter for UI captions and body copy; 500–600 weight for labels.

items.name: Geist
items.description: Vercel's modern geometric sans — Cupric's UI face (Geist Variable, bundled).

data.promptCue: Use Geist for SaaS headlines with tight tracking (−2%).

items.name: Satoshi
items.description: Crisp modernist grotesk from Indian Type Foundry, free on Fontshare. Link-only: install locally, then pick it by name in Studio.

data.license: ITF Free Font License (free personal + commercial use)
data.promptCue: Use Satoshi for bold, friendly startup headlines.

items.name: Simple Icons
items.description: 3,000+ free SVG brand logos (GitHub, Stripe, Figma…). Cupric can drop any of them into Studio from the Brand Kit panel.

data.promptCue: Show partner/brand logos as a slow marquee in one flat colour; never alter the marks.

items.name: Logo.dev
items.description: Logo API: fetch any company's logo by domain (free tier needs a key and attribution). Link-only.

data.license: Logo.dev terms — free tier with attribution
data.promptCue: Fetch customer logos by domain for ‘trusted by’ rows.

items.name: Lucide Icons
items.description: Clean, consistent open-source icon set — already bundled in Cupric and used across the app.

data.promptCue: Use 1.5–2px stroke icons at 20–24px next to feature labels.

items.name: Fontsource
items.description: Self-hosted npm packages for 1,500+ open fonts — how Cupric bundles fonts so preview and export never need the network.

data.license: MIT (fonts under their own open licenses)
data.promptCue: Prefer variable fonts from Fontsource for offline-safe rendering.

items.name: Phosphor Icons
items.description: Flexible icon family in six weights (thin → fill, duotone).

data.promptCue: Use duotone icons for friendly feature grids.
Use for dense dashboards and data scenes.

items.name: unDraw
items.description: Free, colour-customisable open illustrations for explainer scenes.

data.promptCue: Tint illustrations to the brand accent; one per scene.

items.name: LottieFiles (free animations)
items.description: Huge library of free Lottie animations — Cupric imports .json Lottie files into Studio.

data.promptCue: Use a small Lottie accent (check, confetti, arrow) at beat changes.

items.name: Pexels Videos
items.description: Free stock video and photos for b-roll.

data.promptCue: Use 3–5s b-roll behind stats and quotes; darken 30% for legibility.

items.name: Mixkit
items.description: Free stock video clips, music tracks and sound effects.

data.promptCue: Pick music by BPM to match cuts; add a whoosh on transitions.

items.name: Coolors
items.description: Fast colour-palette generator — build a palette, then paste it into the Brand Kit.
